About.title: A developer by passion. An engineer by mindset.
About.p1: I am Mohamad Amin Mansori, a frontend developer focused on React, Next.js and TypeScript. I have been building web applications since 2020 – from my first internship through two years of product development at Batriders to independently delivering complete full-stack projects.
About.p2: My background in Industrial Engineering shapes how I work: I think in processes, measure results and solve problems systematically. I feel at home collaborating with backend teams, designers and clients – clear communication, clean interfaces and reliable handovers.
About.p3: I am currently looking for a new challenge in Germany, remote or on-site. I want to bring my expertise into a strong team and build products people genuinely enjoy using.

Projects.title: Selected work.
Projects.subtitle: Six projects that show how I think and build. This section keeps growing – new projects are on the way.

shoplon.title: Shoplon
shoplon.tagline: A social-commerce platform that turns Instagram shops into full-featured storefronts.
shoplon.overview: Shoplon connects Instagram pages to a modern online shop: users discover products, follow shops, chat, comment and buy – all in a fast, mobile-first interface.
shoplon.challenge: An interface that feels like a social network but offers the reliability of a shop: infinite scroll, real-time chat, profiles, search and comments – without sacrificing performance.
shoplon.solution: Built with Next.js and TypeScript, Tailwind CSS for a consistent UI and Recoil for fine-grained state. REST APIs are consumed via Axios; infinite scroll and code splitting keep the app fast.
shoplon.outcome: A production platform that makes selling through social media significantly easier for merchants – with a buyer experience that feels native.

magreach.title: MagReach Dashboard
magreach.tagline: Admin and advertiser dashboard for a financial-services app.
magreach.overview: MagReach centralizes the management of a finance app in one dashboard: wallet management, user and advertiser administration including their social channels, and analytics for data-driven decisions.
magreach.challenge: Complex business logic – wallets, roles, advertisers and their social accounts – in an interface the team can operate quickly and without errors.
magreach.solution: Next.js with Material UI and Tailwind CSS, Recoil for app state and React Hook Form for robust, validated forms. next-auth secures access.
magreach.outcome: The team manages campaigns, users and analytics in one place – with far less manual effort and clearer decision-making.
features: Validated forms with React Hook Form

gameplanet.title: GamePlanet
gameplanet.tagline: A full-stack rental shop for game consoles – with 3D product views in the browser.
gameplanet.overview: GamePlanet rents out game consoles: users browse the catalog, inspect products in 3D and place orders. A complete dashboard manages products, orders and users; the interface is multi-language.
gameplanet.challenge: A rental shop that goes beyond the standard: 3D product views, end-to-end type safety from database to UI, and a dashboard covering the entire order flow.
gameplanet.solution: Next.js and TypeScript as the foundation, Prisma + tRPC for type-safe APIs, Supabase as the database, next-auth for login and Three.js for interactive product views. i18next makes the app international.
gameplanet.outcome: A complete full-stack product combining design, 3D and clean architecture – deployed on Vercel and ready for real users.

zinamatv.title: ZinemaTV
zinamatv.tagline: A VOD platform with a custom video player and a role-based dashboard for three user types.
zinamatv.overview: ZinemaTV is a video-on-demand platform with a custom-built player. The dashboard I built serves three roles – management, employees and publishers – and controls all content on the main website.
zinamatv.challenge: An editorial system that serves three very different user groups while staying intuitive: managing movies, users and website sections centrally.
zinamatv.solution: React and Material UI for the dashboard, Next.js and Tailwind for the platform, Recoil for state and next-auth for roles. The custom player is tailored to the platform's needs.
zinamatv.outcome: The team maintains the catalog, users and website content entirely on their own – no developer involvement in day-to-day operations.

rentta.title: Rentta
rentta.tagline: A rental marketplace connecting owners and renters – with maps and a dashboard.
rentta.overview: Rentta connects people who rent out things with those who need them: discover listings on a map, send requests, manage everything. A dashboard controls listings, orders and users.
rentta.challenge: A two-sided marketplace with a geo dimension: listings must be discoverable, requests traceable, and management simple for both sides.
rentta.solution: Next.js + Prisma + tRPC as a type-safe full-stack foundation, Supabase for data, Leaflet for the map view, next-auth for login and i18next for multi-language support.
rentta.outcome: A complete platform from idea to deployment – with map search, a dashboard and a clean API architecture.

twitch.title: Twitch UI
twitch.tagline: UI study: a responsive recreation of the Twitch interface with OAuth login.
twitch.overview: A learning and design study: the Twitch.tv interface rebuilt responsively – including login via GitHub and Google. The focus is on layout, reusability and authentication flows.
twitch.challenge: Decomposing a complex, dense UI like Twitch into clean components while preserving responsiveness and performance.
twitch.solution: Next.js with Tailwind CSS for the layout, next-auth for OAuth (GitHub & Google) and the Next.js Image component for optimized lazy loading.
twitch.outcome: A study demonstrating how I analyze complex interfaces, turn them into components and implement auth flows correctly.
